name: scrapeforge
description: Self-hosted visual web scraping platform that runs entirely on localhost.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.build: npm run build -w @scrapeforge/backend && npm run build -w @scrapeforge/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @scrapeforge/backend && npm run typecheck -w @scrapeforge/frontend
